== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[The Guild]] of Witnesses is an [[Imperial]] organization dedicated to the impartial recording and verification of historical events. Functioning as a source of truth, the [[Guild]] provides accurate descriptions of significant occurrences, which can influence public opinion and political stability across [[The Empire|the Empire]]. Their reports are highly influential; for example, they can verify or deny stories released by other entities and provide official documentation for major events like the appointment of an [[Imperial]] heir. Because they speak only the unvarnished truth, their testimony can be used to expose lies or hold other factions accountable. Members of the [[Guild]] typically operate in pairs consisting of two distinct roles: [[Chroniclers]], who are responsible for transcribing and memorizing information, and [[Silent Ones]], who serve as protectors for the [[Chroniclers]]. [[Chroniclers]] are identified by the wax candles they carry at their waists, while [[Silent Ones]] keep their mouths covered and are equipped with various weapons. [[The Guild]] is led by twin heads, [[Azea Farstrider|Azea]] and [[Calazan Farstrider]], who are notable for their ability to perform both roles interchangeably. The leadership is characterized by their shared appearance, featuring pale hair and similar attire consisting of loose-fitting clothing tied at the wrists and ankles.}}
